summary: High-quality ZnO thin films were grown on sapphire substrates using atomic layer epitaxy (ALE) with diethylzinc (DEZn) and H2O as precursors at substrate temperatures of 170 and 400 ◦C. The films were annealed at various temperatures between 600 and 1000 ◦C to study the effect on optical properties. The best crystalline quality was achieved when the films were deposited at 170 ◦C and annealed at 1000 ◦C.
